Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::makeNewOrder(orderid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingOrder: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderid)
	precondition:
		orderid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer)
	postcondition:
		let ob: OrderProduct in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		ob.Id = orderid and
		ob.Time = now and
		ob.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::NEW and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct = ob and
		result = true or
		existingOrder.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct = existingOrder and
		result = false
}
